title: Claimable
tagline: Airdrops are great, but did you miss any? How about POAPs? Now you'll know. Has been used to claim over $50,000USD already.
description:
Claimable helps Ethereum users find free money. We aggregate all known airdrops and POAP tokens on one page. Enter your public address and see if you have anything waiting to claim!

In 2020, if you were an active user of DeFi, you earned over $20,000 USD in airdrops, yet knowing you have unclaimed airdrops is tricky! And POAPs, even on the POAP site, you have to put in your wallet address for each individual POAP to know if you have one to claim!

Use Claimable and know instantly!
how_its_made:
React, Node.js, styled-components



I'm great at frontend and wanted to see how useful a simple web app could be. With over 500 likes on Twitter, we see this was VERY desired from the community. Keep iterating until you find something people love!
